summary: Google DeepMind released a minor version update to the SynthID-Text library fixing typos, improving device-comparison reliability, and adding Python 3.9 compatibility with CI testing.

practices.reason: A minor library update adds Python 3.9 compatibility and CI testing that could affect teams already depending on this package.
